meta.disclaimer: A permitted operation is not by itself proof of contamination. Permitted large operations, documented NPDES enforcement or single-event violations, Iowa DNR listed operations, and USDA disease detections are stored as distinct sub-layers. Living near a listed operation does not necessarily mean a person is at risk.
meta.coordinate_policy: Coordinates are used only when an official dataset publishes them (EPA ICIS-NPDES facility GEOCODE_LATITUDE/GEOCODE_LONGITUDE, or Iowa DNR Facilities layer latitude/longitude). This project never geocodes addresses or place names. ICIS coordinates are marked approximate because the public download does not include a collection method. Iowa DNR points whose official collection method is address matching are also marked approximate. Every mapped point was tested against GADM 4.1 United States level-1 boundaries with a 1 km coastal tolerance; failures are withheld from the map and kept as list-only. USDA APHIS HPAI detections have no official farm coordinates and are list-only or county/state shaded, never plotted as points.
